_comment: Rule-based empathy-strategy selector. score_empathy sums matched keyword weights per signal; select_strategy combines those signals with the intent to pick one of the six strategies. 'fallback_llm_classification' is used only when no signal is confident.

emotion_expression._desc: User is voicing a feeling / affect.

solution_request._desc: User is asking for help solving / deciding something.

sharing_wish._desc: User just wants to talk / be heard, no task.

task_intent._desc: Clear functional request with little affect.

strategy_descriptions.cognitive: 인지적 공감. 상황을 정리하고 해결책을 제안합니다.
strategy_descriptions.sharing: 공유적 공감. 일반적인 상황으로 함께 공감합니다.
strategy_descriptions.mixed_affective_cognitive: 감정 인정과 해결 제안을 함께 하는 혼합 전략입니다.
strategy_descriptions.direct_task: 감정보다 기능 수행이 명확할 때 사용하는 전략입니다.
strategy_descriptions.fallback_llm_classification: rule-based 분류가 애매할 때 사용하는 fallback 전략입니다.
